customer_updates.text: Nice place you can get what you want for groceries

customer_updates.name: pat ninne
customer_updates.text:
Yesterday's Growel 101 mall Kandivali east pic near Big Bazar entrance. Festive lighting   seen near the gate near far end in the pic. Inside Big Bazar, unlike  a year back, now we can see all racks are full with various different items.
The ready-made clothes section  is stocked with good quality clothes. On some clothes 40% discounts was also seen.
At cash counter i was told that digital payments like paytm are presently not being accepted.
In the growel mall like in past growel reward points can be accumulated by showing the bills at the counter which may be used for paying for car parking charges.
Food court on 3rd floor is good.

customer_updates.name: Sudip Pawar
customer_updates.text: Big Bazaar is open from 10 AM - 10 PM for all essentials at Growel's 101! Also, enjoy Mahabachat Offer till 15th Aug.

featured_reviews.name: Shashidhar Karindi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very organized store, though a bit crowded. The staff are well-behaved. It's the best shopping bazaar in this area, and the prices are reasonable.

Parking is convenient and close to the metro. You can enjoy a great shopping experience here.also there is kids play zone area

Note: Don’t miss trying the chai/tea!"

featured_reviews.name: Neha Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: Usually big bazaar is very crowded but due to covid-19 the amount of people visiting has reduced quite a lot! The amount and variety of products has also reduced because many aisles were seen empty. Temperatures are checked at the entrance, sanitizers are also available. They also check in through Aarogya Setu app. Basic necessity items are available are quite low prices. Overall a fine experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mumbaikar Indian
featured_reviews.review_text:
One place for all your essential needs.  Wish it, Get it.
Right from grocessary to home decor, you get everything here at very reasonable rates.  Middle class people can match their expectations here off course.
The place is besides Growels Mall, so you can enjoy much when you shop.
If you are planning to go for an easy shopping, visit the place in workings days to avoid rush.  During weekends, you will need to wait in queues for billings. But why not, when they can make you smile when you shop.

Definitely recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Shukla
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is decent and crowded at the same time. While I could not find some of the items, one can get almost everything they need. I would however recommend carry a non-plastic bag as they charge high price for cloth bag since now plastic is banned. There's growels 101 mall right besides. There's a pickup/drop service of auto rickshaws near the parking area.

featured_reviews.name: Harshada Temkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The entry to this mall is only to fully vaccinated people.
So, it was not so crowded. Hence shopping could be done peacefully. Even the play zone was quite empty.
Overall was a nice change after so many months of stay at home.

featured_reviews.name: Anshrit Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Shopping was nice i kept my phone inside the bag and locked it (unknowingly) so i was not Abel to provide an inside pic but yeah a bunch offer to attract customers and all the groceries were available I guess you will enjoy it

featured_reviews.name: Sushil Vanka
featured_reviews.review_text: Well maintained, many things available, readymade garments choice is decent for normal wear. Good discounts on products. Clean place, less crowd, though not totally empty. Got to see F1 car & drive a simulator.

featured_reviews.name: Viraj Achrekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a terrible experience at this general store. The staff here behave in the most disrespectful and unprofessional manner. While I was simply browsing, one of them rudely said, “Niklo yaha se, ghoomne nahi aate, jo lena hai woh lo aur niklo.” I was shocked. This is not how any customer deserves to be treated.

I wasn’t causing any disturbance—I was just looking around to decide what to buy. But their behavior made me feel extremely unwelcome and insulted. It’s clear they have zero training in basic customer service and even less respect for people.

Let me make it clear: I’m not letting this go. I’m going to take serious action regarding this. I will be reporting this incident to the local consumer rights authority and posting this experience on every possible platform to make others aware.

If you value dignity and good service, stay away from this place. There are far better stores where customers are actually respected.

The owner refuses to take the product back or exchange it.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Routray
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Hari Om Supermarket  and unfortunately, my experience was far from pleasant. The owner and staff were quite rude, making the entire visit uncomfortable. In addition to the unfriendly attitude, the service was extremely slow, which added to the frustration. I expected better customer service and a more efficient shopping experience, but sadly, that was not the case. I hope they work on improving both their behavior and service quality for future customers.

Update: Making this update since google doesnt allow replies on your review, when i tried to share my experience the shopkeeper has tried to silence my voice by making false and threatening accusations, which you can see in the their below reply. I  leave the rest to the reader's discretion, I shared my experience so that others can make an informed decision.

featured_reviews.name: Remona Ray
featured_reviews.review_text: The behavior of the owner is very rude. Today, I went to buy some potatoes and onions. I needed small potatoes, and the salesperson next to me was packing some that included smaller ones. I asked if I could exchange my larger ones for those, but instead of responding politely, he behaved rudely. I didn’t say anything to him, but I reported the issue to the owner. Instead of understanding the situation, the owner started arguing with me and was also rude. I didn’t buy the groceries and left. I don’t think I’ll be visiting there again, and I’ll suggest others avoid it too. If the owner is rude, what can we expect from the staff? There are better supermarkets in Thakur Complex—far better than Hari Om.

featured_reviews.name: Shailesh Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: The online payments done and which are not credited instantly are not returned until the customer follows up with the shop owner repeatedly. The owner asks you to leave the goods too and keeps the money which gets credited to his account too. The items in the shop are priced way above than their actual price should be. 'Indian Supermarket' located nearby is a better choice when it comes to price, quality and customer service. Also as mentioned by others, the owner is rude and has no manners on how to talk with customers.

featured_reviews.name: Sunil subba
featured_reviews.review_text: Sir, I have been shopping at the DMart in Thakur Village, Kandivali, since 2013, but when I went shopping on June 2, 2026, I was treated very strangely. I was shocked that such things happen at DMart; nothing like this had ever happened before, even though I had shopped there in similar quantities previously. On this occasion, I had picked up 4 boxes of oil and other items, totaling around ₹9,000 worth of goods. When I took the items to the billing counter, a lady came over and told me I couldn't buy all those items; she said I was allowed only one box of oil and just two pieces of the other items. I told her this wasn't the first time I had bought such a large quantity—I had done so many times before—but she wouldn't listen and simply walked away. So, I left all the items right there at the counter. I felt truly disheartened by DMart; they ruined years of good experience in a single day. Since then, I have switched to Smart Bazaar. At Smart Bazaar, no one questions me regardless of how much I buy, because they actually want to sell their goods. DMart is the exact opposite; they don't seem interested in selling—they just want the store to look fully stocked. The staff is terrible, and the system is flawed. DMart management really needs to pay attention to what is happening in their stores. I felt terrible about not being allowed to purchase the items after waiting in line for so long. A heartfelt thank you to Smart Bazaar.
